name: W. A. Towers
role: Partner in Towers & Gudgell, Colorado and Montana ranchmen
bio: W. A. Towers was a partner in Towers & Gudgell, Colorado and Montana ranchmen, and in August 1884 the paper reported his marriage at Decatur, Georgia, to Miss Fannie Hillyer. In May 1885, at a convention on the new cattle trail, he was the one conference committee member who did not sign a report favoring the trail, explaining his position as following his association's instructions.
